fields.description: Issue includes local political coverage focused on conflict within Miami city government and criticism of Mayor Sewell’s leadership and proposed business/liquor fees. A major feature reports on a legal challenge involving the Miami Jockey Club and pari-mutuel operations, including interrogatories filed in circuit court that raise questions about horse-racing finances and alleged corruption. The issue also contains nightlife and entertainment listings/advertising, sports-related items (including racing tips and boxing promotions), radio program schedules, and assorted local columns and notices.
